title: tc-quality-trend
description:
Judge scores on live chats day by day, a line per criterion with a band from its sample size, the changes pinned on
the time axis, a 7 / 30 / 90-day switch, and a table view.

description.description: A line under the heading – the agent, the judge

criteria.description: The criteria the judge scores, in legend order

days.description: One entry per day, any order – the last day is the end of every range

changes.description: The changes made to the agent – prompts, models, tools – pinned where they went live

shown.description: The ids of the criteria drawn; null draws every one

view.description: "chart", or "table" for the same days as a table

min.description: The lowest score on the scale

max.description: The highest score on the scale

spread.description: A score's spread (standard deviation) when a day gives none – sets the band's width with the day's chats

threshold.description: How far a mean must move for the summary to call it a change

timeZone.description: The time zone dates are read in – UTC by default, so a day's midnight stays that day

color.description: Any CSS colour; unset takes --tc-chart-1…6 in order

date.description: The day, as epoch ms – midnight UTC by default (see `timeZone`)

scores.description: The day's score per criterion id; a criterion with none that day leaves a gap in its line

QualityScore.description: One criterion's scores on one day: the mean, how many chats were scored, and their spread if known

at.description: When it went live, as epoch ms

label.description: What changed, in a few words – "Prompt v13 → v14"

short.description: The short name the summary uses – "v14"; defaults to the label

detail.description: A line more, shown in the pin's tooltip
